Q201.why: Ideal-diode FET in the north row beside U201 (D21 C: DGATE 23 mm): sources (VBAT_IN) face west to the L of VBAT_IN from J910, tab (VBAT_D) faces the shunt's F1. Mirror image of Q202 about x 155.

Q202.why: Ideal-diode FET fed by J901, Q201 turned 180° about x 155: sources east to J901's L of VBAT_IN, tab faces F1; DGATE 24 mm (D21 C).

Q203.why: Load-disconnect FET in the south row: tab (VBAT_Q2D) faces the shunt's F2, sources (VBAT_PROT) face west; VBAT_PROT leaves south toward U701 and on In3 toward U601 (D21 C).

Q204.why: Load-disconnect FET, Q203 turned 180° about x 155; sources (VBAT_PROT) east, toward U801.
